'''Lowle Ch'red''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The woman was a frequenter of [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] and the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Ch'red ate at the Diner when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited to talk with diner owner [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]].

==Biography==
Lowle Ch'red<ref name="SWDB" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="AotC" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]] whose [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was<ref name="SWDB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SWDB" /> Before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="SWDB" /> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="AotC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Ch'red frequented [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="SWDB" /> in Coruscant's [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district,<ref name="CL" /> and the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="SWDB" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the world's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> The woman was also acquainted with the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]]<ref name="SWDB" /> hired thug<ref name="tk">{{DB|character|taskee|Kee, Tas}}</ref> [[Tas Kee]].<ref name="SWDB" />

In 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> after the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|attempted assassination]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], Ch'red visited Dex's Diner, sitting alone at a window bar whilst eating and drinking. While Ch'red did so, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited to ask diner owner [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] about a<ref name="AotC" /> [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|Mk I Saberdart]]<ref name="EV">''[[Endless Vigil]]''</ref> used in the assassination attempt. As the [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]]<ref name="AotC" /> [[Bogg Tyrell/Legends|Bogg Tyrell]]<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> entered the diner, Ch'red put the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] they were eating back into a dish and brushed off her hands.<ref name="AotC" />

==Personality and traits==
Ch'red had light skin.<ref name="AotC" /> "Lowle" was a feminine first name of Human origin.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
While at Dex's Diner, the woman wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Clothing/Legends|top]], a separate black collar, a silver armband, and a pair of black [[Limb/Legends|fingerless]] [[Glove/Legends|gloves]]. Ch'red also wore a large black headdress with curving shapes at its front.<ref name="AotC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LowleChred.png|thumb|right|250px|An extra (pictured) was replaced by Lowle Ch'red after filming.]]
An uncredited extra played Lowle Ch'red in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AotC" /> The character was digitally added after filming, replacing<ref name="CompleteSaga">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Complete Saga|featurette=Dexter Jettster Maquette}}</ref> a different extra, with dark skin, black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of geometrical design on her chest.<ref name="SWDB" /> The extra also wore an outfit similar to Ch'red in the finished film.<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

The character, using the original extra's design, first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 2|second issue]] of the film's [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones (comic series)|comic adaptation]], written by [[Henry Gilroy]], illustrated by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="Comic">[[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 2|''Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones'' 2]]</ref> and published on [[April 24]], [[2002]],<ref name="ComicDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/00-470/Star-Wars-Episode-II----Attack-of-the-Clones-2|text=Star Wars: Episode II -- Attack of the Clones #2}}</ref> ahead of Episode II's [[May 16]], 2002, release date.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The character was then first identified in the Episode II [[Depth Commentary]] available on [[StarWars.com]], accessible through the DVD-ROM [[Star Wars home video releases|home release]] of ''Attack of the Clones''<ref name="Depth" /> released on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref>

''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]<ref name="aotcvis">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and published on [[April 23]], 2002,<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20020227.html|text=Book Preview: DK Episode II Books}}</ref> included the tattooed extra and described them as a professional kidnapper, but also included a picture of Ch'red in the film.<ref name="aotcvis" /> The character's StarWars.com [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry,<ref name="SWDB" /> and its associated update post,<ref name="Women">{{SWArchive|url=fans/media/womenofsw/index.html?page=3|text=The Women of ''Star Wars'': The Women of the Prequel Trilogy}}</ref> later used an image of the tattooed extra instead of Ch'red's depiction in the film.<ref name="SWDB" /> The [[2013]] Denmark-exclusive [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Ultimate Illustrated Guide|update]]<ref name="AOTCVDEDate">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-attack-of-the-clones-the-expanded-visual-dictionary-the-book-i-didnt-know-existed|text=''Star Wars Attack of the Clones: The Expanded Visual Dictionary'' &mdash; The Book I Didn't Know Existed}}</ref> to the ''Visual Dictionary'' maintained the reference to the removed extra.<ref name="AOTCVDE">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Ultimate Illustrated Guide]]''</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member<ref name="Hyp">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/postnotes/news20041124.html|series=Episode III Post Notes|text=Part of the Coruscant Elite}}</ref> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] stated on [[Wikipedia:X (social network)|Twitter]] that the tattooed extra was casted for costume photography, and the on-screen extra is Lowle Ch'red,<ref name="Day399">{{WebCite|url=https://365starwars.com/2019/07/05/day-399-lowle-chred/|text=Day 399 – Lowle Ch’red|archivedate=20260216140338}}</ref> not addressing the behind-the-scenes footage where the tattooed extra is visible on set.<ref name="CompleteSaga" />
